t: Malawian Kwacha (MWK): Meaning, History, Malawian Economy
s: August 26, 2020 - The term Malawian kwacha (MWK) refers to the official national currency of Malawi. It is abbreviated as MWK in the foreign exchange (forex) market and is commonly represented by the symbol K. The currency is issued and maintained by Malawi's central bank. One kwacha is divided into 100 tambalas.
